gloss: to get along well; to hit it off; to be compatible

definitions.gloss: to get along well; to hit it off; to be compatible
definitions.explanation: to have a natural affinity or compatibility with someone, sharing similar tastes, interests, or temperament

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{合|あ}う。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{気|き}が{合|あ}った。
examples.english: Even though we met for the first time, we hit it off right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{合|あ}う⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Maybe I get along with him because we have the same hobbies.

notes:
An idiomatic expression using ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, feeling, temperament) and ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to match, to fit). Describes a natural compatibility between people — a sense that personalities, interests, or values align well.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{合|あ}う: to get along with someone
- {気|き}が{合|あ}う⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: like-minded companions
- {気|き}が{合|あ}う⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧: a friend you click with

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to hit it off — similar meaning but slightly more casual; literally "the horses match"
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}がいい→相性がいい：22113_aishougaii⟧: to be compatible — broader, also used for romantic compatibility and object compatibility
- {気|き}が{合|あ}わない: to not get along — the negative form, used when personalities clash

USAGE:
Typically used with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ to indicate the person one gets along with. The subject is often implied rather than stated explicitly.

cross_references.label: to hit it off, to get along instantly
